mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as improved labor market conditions boost corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite UNRATE crossing below 4.0% in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and supply-side index (INDPRO) indicates balanced demand and supply growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase simultaneously
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase concurrently (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (e.g., rising FEDFUNDS), S&P 500 forward returns are predicted to be negative over the next 5 trading days as higher interest rates reduce discounted cash flows.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the CPIAUCSL inflation index signals lower inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate looser monetary policy.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite CPIAUCSL declining steadily over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When the HOUST demand indicator exceeds 1200 units, it signals robust demand growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive despite HOUST crossing above 1200 in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rise (tightening) while UNRATE fall (improving labor market), the combined effect of contractionary monetary policy and strong labor demand leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: contractionary monetary policy with improving labor market
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS increasing and UNRATE decreasing in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by high quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1), S&P 500 forward returns are predicted to be negative over the next 60 trading days as market anticipates peak and correction.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive during periods where GDPC1 exceeds 10000, indicating a late-cycle expansion phase.
